items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares first Jalapeño inference-chip results
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布 Jalapeño 自研推論晶片首批實測結果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released measured results for Jalapeño, its first custom inference accelerator co-developed with Broadcom. On the public InferenceX benchmark across GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K2.5 1T, it reported 1.5–1.9× more AI work per watt at peak throughput and 1.7–3.6× lower end-to-end latency than comparison systems (including Nvidia Blackwell-class). Small-volume deployment is targeted by end-2026, with broader ramp in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布與 Broadcom 合作的首款自研推論加速器 Jalapeño 實測結果。在公開 InferenceX 基準上，對 GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek R1 與 Kimi K2.5 1T 等模型，峰值每瓦產出達對照系統的 1.5–1.9 倍，端到端延遲降低 1.7–3.6 倍。預計 2026 年底小量部署、2027 年擴大。
items_flat.analysis_en: First-party silicon with published cross-model numbers strengthens OpenAI’s full-stack claim and creates a credible alternative path to merchant GPUs for inference economics. Real-world volume, software maturity and competition from next-gen Nvidia parts remain the key uncertainties before cost impact is clear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 有公開跨模型數據的自研晶片強化 OpenAI 全棧論述，並為推論成本提供有別於商業 GPU 的路徑。實際量產規模、軟體成熟度與下一代 Nvidia 晶片競爭，仍是成本效益能否兌現的關鍵不確定因素。
items_flat.quote: Jalapeño can serve more AI work per unit of power while also returning responses more quickly.
items_flat.quote_zh: Jalapeño 能以更低功耗服務更多 AI 工作，同時更快回傳回應。

items_flat.title_zh: Z.ai 發布開源多模態 GLM-5.3-Flash
items_flat.summary_en: Z.ai launched GLM-5.3-Flash, a natively multimodal model (320B total / 18B active parameters) under the MIT license with a 1M-token context. It reports strong coding and agentic results approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on several internal and public benchmarks while pricing at roughly one-tenth prior levels. Weights are available on Hugging Face; inference ran at scale on Chinese AI chips during preview.
items_flat.summary_zh: Z.ai 推出原生多模態 GLM-5.3-Flash（總參數 320B、啟動 18B），採 MIT 授權並支援 1M token 上下文。官方稱在多項 coding 與 agent 基準上接近 Claude Opus 4.8，價格約為先前水準的十分之一。權重已上 Hugging Face，預覽期間在中國自研晶片上規模服務。
items_flat.analysis_en: An efficient open multimodal model that runs competitively on non-Nvidia silicon expands the practical options for cost-sensitive coding agents and local/sovereign deployments. Independent verification of the reported benchmark deltas and long-context behavior will determine how widely it is adopted.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 能在非 Nvidia 晶片上高效運行的開源多模態模型，為成本敏感的 coding agent 與本地/主權部署增加實際選項。公開基準差距與長上下文行為的獨立驗證，將決定其採用廣度。
items_flat.quote: With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 總參數 320B、僅 18B 啟動參數，在基準與真實工作負載上優於 GLM-5.2，價格約十分之一，同時在 coding 與 agent 基準上接近 Claude Opus 4.8。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic unifies Claude memory across chat and Cowork
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 統一 Claude 聊天與 Cowork 記憶系統
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that Claude’s memory is now shared between regular chat and Claude Cowork. Memories update live during conversation, appear as editable topic files in settings, and sensitive topics (health, beliefs, etc.) stay off by default with an explicit opt-in. Memory is on by default for Free/Pro/Max; Team/Enterprise remain admin-controlled.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude 記憶現在在一般聊天與 Claude Cowork 之間共享。記憶會在對話中即時更新，並以可編輯的主題檔案呈現於設定中；健康、信念等敏感主題預設不儲存，需明確開啟。Free/Pro/Max 預設開啟，Team/Enterprise 由管理員控制。
items_flat.analysis_en: Shared, inspectable memory reduces friction for multi-step agent workflows and makes long-running context practical. The privacy controls are clearer than many peers, yet the permanent linkage between chat and agent surfaces still raises questions about data retention and organizational governance.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可檢視、可編輯的共享記憶降低多步驟代理工作的重複說明成本，使長期脈絡更實用。隱私控制比多數對手更明確，但聊天與代理介面永久連動，仍會引發資料保存與組織治理疑慮。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, the memory you use in chat is the same as in Claude Cowork. Now, wherever you work with Claude, it starts from what it already knows about you.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從今天起，你在聊天中使用的記憶與 Claude Cowork 相同。無論在哪裡使用 Claude，它都會從已知道的內容開始。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and HUMAIN announce sovereign-AI collaboration in Saudi Arabia
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 與 HUMAIN 宣布沙烏地主權 AI 合作
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and Saudi PIF-backed HUMAIN announced a strategic collaboration valued in the hundreds of millions of euros covering AI infrastructure, model localization (initial focus cybersecurity and voice, plus Arabic-strong frontier models), and joint go-to-market in regulated industries. Mistral will explore using HUMAIN data-center capacity for regional compute.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 與沙烏地主權基金支持的 HUMAIN 宣布價值數億歐元的戰略合作，涵蓋 AI 基礎設施、模型在地化（初期聚焦網路安全與語音，以及阿拉伯語強勢的前沿模型），以及受監管產業的聯合市場策略。Mistral 將探索使用 HUMAIN 資料中心容量服務區域算力需求。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal extends Mistral’s sovereign-compute push beyond Europe into the Gulf and gives both parties a path to localized models and infrastructure. Execution risk remains high until concrete capacity and model releases materialize.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此合作將 Mistral 的主權算力布局從歐洲延伸至海灣地區，並為雙方提供在地模型與基礎設施路徑。在具體容量與模型實際落地前，執行風險仍高。
items_flat.quote: This represents a collaboration in the hundreds of millions of Euros.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此合作規模達數億歐元。

brief_en: OpenAI published first Jalapeño inference-chip benchmarks claiming 1.5–1.9× work-per-watt and lower latency vs leading systems. Anthropic unified Claude memory across chat and Cowork with user-editable topics. Z.ai released open-weights multimodal GLM-5.3-Flash (320B-A18B) under MIT, strong on coding/agents at low cost.
brief_zh: OpenAI 公布 Jalapeño 自研推論晶片首批實測，宣稱每瓦效能與延遲優於領先系統。Anthropic 統一 Claude 聊天與 Cowork 記憶並開放編輯。Z.ai 開源多模態 GLM-5.3-Flash（320B-A18B），低成本接近前沿 coding/agent 水準。
